file_change_proposal.description: outside src/, and the policy carries a stray empty entry

note: SC-9/A1(c) pin for normalizePrefixes. An empty or whitespace-only entry carries no bound. Before normalization it would have matched every path, so `allowed_paths: ['', 'src/']` would silently permit everything -- a policy that reads restrictive and behaves as none. Reverting normalizePrefixes alone flips this fixture from fail to pass.
